integrity: The infinite claim is proved algebraically from the four published inequalities. The finite enumeration artifact is used only as a reproducibility and regression check, not as a proof. The source manuscript and the actual companion solver implementation were both inspected.
limitations: The theorem is exact only for the published one-braid optimization problem; it supplies an upper bound for the toric mosaic number, not an equality for that invariant. The source's full-braid construction can do better in part of the \(p=2\) family, and other constructions may improve the bound elsewhere. Uncatalogued parallel work remains a residual originality risk.
title: Closed-form optimizer for the one-braid toric-mosaic construction
